objectives.title: Build one multisensory integration architecture that carries omics, in-situ and remote-sensing observation on a single pressure gradient
objectives.measurable_output: A prioritised knowledge-gap and data-need analysis, and an integration architecture specification covering the molecular, plot, airborne and satellite layers
objectives.source_ref: Concept note, 'The chain, from genome to space'; claims C01-C03 and C16 of project_summary.json
objectives.note: The gap analysis runs before the architecture, in the order the scope requirement states. The architecture is specified once and then tested three times, once per realm.

objectives.title: Agree joint data-collection, metadata and processing protocols, and publish them with crosswalks to the European habitat classification and the global ecosystem typology
objectives.measurable_output: One protocol set adopted across the three cases, a crosswalk package, a provenance-tracked pipeline release, and publication to the open science cloud and the common data spaces
objectives.source_ref: Concept note, 'The chain, from genome to space' and 'Coordination the topic requires'; claims C08, C09, C15, C18 and C23
objectives.note: The scope asks the project to contribute to consensus, not only to comply. The contribution to the standards bodies is a task, not a dissemination line.

objectives.title: Turn the multi-season field archive and the case observations into documented training and validation resources
objectives.measurable_output: A published training and validation resource with a declared split protocol, in which site, season and treatment travel together into one fold
objectives.source_ref: Concept note, 'Training and validation data'; claim C06
objectives.note: The split protocol is the objective, not a detail of it. A resource whose folds leak the site teaches a model to recognise the site.

objectives.title: Run three demonstration and verification cases along one agricultural pressure gradient, across the terrestrial, freshwater and marine realms
objectives.measurable_output: Three harmonised observation datasets, one per realm, and a cross-case report on which harmonisation decisions survived transfer between realms
objectives.source_ref: Concept note, 'Three demonstration cases on one gradient'; claims C04, C05 and C13
objectives.note: One gradient rather than three sites. A harmonisation decision taken for farmland is then tested in two realms that did not design it.

objectives.title: Deliver habitat and ecosystem classification and biodiversity trend prediction at case, regional and European scales
objectives.measurable_output: Benchmarked classification models for the three cases, European-scale habitat and ecosystem maps, and trend predictions with stated uncertainty
objectives.source_ref: Concept note, 'Training and validation data'; claims C07 and C17
objectives.note: Three scales, because the scope names three. The European scale rests on the case models, so it cannot be delivered before them.

objectives.title: Carry the validated indicators into policy reporting and into farm management, so biodiversity evidence reaches the sectors that create the pressure
objectives.measurable_output: A reporting-needs assessment agreed with competent authorities, an indicator decision-support release, and a usability evaluation run through a multi-country network of agricultural holdings
objectives.source_ref: Concept note, 'Reaching agriculture'; claims C10, C14, C19 and C20
objectives.note: The topic names agriculture twice, as a pressure and as a sector to reach. This objective answers the second naming.

coverage.note: Both directions. Every expected outcome and every scope requirement is answered by at least one objective, and every objective answers at least one expected outcome. Checked by tests/test_demo_architecture_seeds.py.
